Issue/revoke/rotate each narrow application credential at its actual issuer, using the approved renewal procedure and pod restart rules.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Platform deployment owner with EventStore, Tenants and Parties owners
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Supply both exact environment bindings and release/enrollment records; registry issuer, authoritative deployment and two explicitly approved tenants. No existing target established.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Platform identity/secret operations with each capability owner
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Supply credential references, only-writer policies, renewal owners and procedures for every role. Generic shared bootstrap and recovery credentials are ineligible substitutes.

Select a qualified existing backend/key hierarchy and show per-original-unit irreversible destruction of every generation, including historical immutable key backups. Reject soft delete, TTL, tombstones and merely denied reads.
Name the independent authority outside the EventStore/OpenBao/ciphertext restore cut; writers, fence/reissue procedure, authenticated time source, skew and currentness bounds.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Platform recovery owner and each copy owner
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Close C01–C16 with real locations/generations or authenticated absence; durable work and original receipts, owner-approved targets and independent probes; define receipt minimization and retention.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Platform expiry/monitoring operators and key owner
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Name cleanup, escalation and renewal operators; approve bounded retries, outage and receipt-completion limits and prove cryptographic expiry during outage. The five-second library wait is not an expiry SLA.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Parties domain owner, EventStore SDK owner and Platform custody owner
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Approve collision/idempotency identity and exact original-binding lookup for establish/rebind/revoke. Revocation effectiveAt cannot create a later deadline for predecessor actor evidence; SDK AdmitAsync lacks binding/logical ID.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Platform host owner with Parties and EventStore integration owners
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Approve package/bootstrap path in both actual owning hosts, Party snapshot codec and payload adapter, retained-source reader and independent source admission; no no-op/local-dev fallback.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Parties privacy/domain owner with Platform/8.6 recovery owners
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Preserve immediate profile ineligibility and independently bounded actor history; decide all key/backup erasure boundaries and minimal content-free anchor/receipt/continuation retention. Reconcile ordinary backup-key retention with hard actor-purpose expiry.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Parties and EventStore source-contract owners, with Platform authority and privacy owners
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Approve proof producer/schema/version/scope/positions/epochs/currentness and erasure classification that proves complete unique successor versions/intervals without retaining expired predecessor actor/provenance/logical evidence. Current strict fold stays closed until accepted.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Administrator/recovery owner, actual deputy and surviving-authority fence owners
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: Supply exact isolated target, immutable cut, authority reconciliation/epoch hooks, independent observer, outage approval, cleanup scope and verified disposal bound. No target selected.

Supply exact workload UIDs and faults for admission/copy/destruction/receipt commit and lost acknowledgement; operator/observer credentials, duration, abort, cleanup and rollback. 6.1 rollout faults alone do not cover custody failure probes.

decisionRequests.requestedDecisionRole: Project owner acting as Parties Maintainer; Platform and EventStore delivery owners; Product for Branch B launch contract
decisionRequests.requiredOutcome: After decisions, implementation and installed probes exist, accept immutable source/package/image targets, integration date, exact complete Live command and all P-01–P-10 evidence. Keep status Committed until that owner-accepted command passes from clean exact checkouts.

acceptance.existingAcceptedCommand: test "$(git -C ../parties rev-parse HEAD)" = "56cb4401c4179d431385ad3d931fefa402e4fc5a" && test -z "$(git -C ../parties status --porcelain)" && pwsh -NoProfile -File ../parties/eng/verify-ext-parties-1.ps1 -Mode Live -EventStoreRoot ../eventstore -PlatformRoot ../platform -EvidenceDirectory /tmp/ext-parties-1-live
acceptance.availabilityGate: Only an owner-accepted full Live command passing on clean exact checkouts with installed targets and all independent persisted assertions can establish Available. Local and LiveReadiness cannot establish it.

resourceScope.emptyAllowlistMeans: No resource mutation is authorized; this is not an attestation that an installation requires zero resources.
resourceScope.bindingRule: Owner-supplied rendered object tuples must equal the complete approved allowlist before dry-run or install; application identity cannot own data/environment-layer objects. Record actual created UIDs and require exact matching on later operations.
